# Docs frame

**Goal**: Six contract pages and an index under `docs/contract/` are generated by a drift test from the committed schema files and manifests, in A5's fixed frame, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` records the frame. Refusals and Notes stay placeholders for `docs_refusals`.
**Pre-conditions**:
- [ ] [cmd] The leaf's worktree is its own checkout: `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps | jq -r .workspace_root` prints the worktree path
- [ ] [cmd] Phase 0 is in: `test -f docs/contract/codes.toml && test -f crates/candler/tests/guard_cli_surface.rs`
- [ ] [cmd] The wire is in, and the schemas declare classes: `test -f crates/candler-schemas/src/refusal.rs && test -f crates/candler-schemas/tests/vectors/field_classes.toml && git grep -q 'x-candler-class' -- crates/candler-schemas/schema/experiment.schema.json crates/candler-schemas/schema/outcome-record.schema.json`
- [ ] [cmd] The manifests the index reads exist: `test -f crates/candler-schemas/Cargo.toml && test -f python/candler-evaluator/pyproject.toml && grep -q '^version' Cargo.toml`
- [ ] [nl] OWNED: `crates/candler/tests/contract_pages.rs`, `crates/candler/tests/support/contract_pages/**`, `docs/contract/*.md` (never `codes.toml`, and never `driver-traits.md`, which M4 writes by hand), `CONTRIBUTING.md` (the new §Contract pages only), `scripts/contract_versions.py`. No `Cargo.toml`, no `Cargo.lock`, no schema file
**Success Gates**:
- ⬜ [cmd] OWNED: `test -z "$(git diff --name-only <base>..HEAD | grep -vE '^(crates/candler/tests/(contract_pages\.rs|support/contract_pages/)|docs/contract/[a-z-]+\.md$|CONTRIBUTING\.md$|scripts/contract_versions\.py$)')"`, `<base>` being the leaf's branch point
- ⬜ [cmd] D1 ★ regenerating changes nothing: `cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'test(/^d1_/)'` and `CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT=1 cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'binary(contract_pages)' && test -z "$(git status --porcelain docs/contract)"`
- ⬜ [cmd] D2 frame: `cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'test(/^d2_/)'`
- ⬜ [cmd] D4, the compatibility half: `cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'test(/^d4_/)'`
- ⬜ [cmd] The seven files exist, the driver page is left alone: `for f in index plugin-manifest suite-file evaluator-protocol outcome-record experiment-file evaluator-helper; do test -f docs/contract/$f.md || exit 1; done && git diff --quiet <base>..HEAD -- docs/contract/driver-traits.md && grep -q 'driver-traits.md' docs/contract/index.md`
- ⬜ [cmd] No development process in the pages or the section: `! grep -n -i -E 'milestone|roadmap|amendment|leaf|campaign|\bM[0-9]\b|\bA5\b' docs/contract/*.md && test -z "$(awk '/^## Contract pages/{f=1;next} /^## /{f=0} f' CONTRIBUTING.md | grep -i -E 'milestone|roadmap|amendment|leaf|campaign|\bM[0-9]\b|\bA5\b')"`
- ⬜ [cmd] CONTRIBUTING holds the frame: `grep -q '^## Contract pages' CONTRIBUTING.md && awk '/^## Contract pages/{f=1;next} /^## /{f=0} f' CONTRIBUTING.md | grep -q 'CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT'`
- ⬜ [cmd] No schema, no code outside the tests moved: `git diff --quiet <base>..HEAD -- crates/candler-schemas crates/candler-core crates/candler/src python`
- ⬜ [cmd] STD (the `-p candler` forms) and SUBJ pass
- ⬜ [nl] The leaf report records the bites:
  - D1: a property added to a copy of a committed schema without regenerating; a hand-edited cell of a Fields table;
  - D2: an extra `##` section; an unstamped note; a Notes section of 121 words; sections out of order;
  - D4: a stale version in the table
- ⬜ [cmd] The version blocks equal the manifests, by a script the release job can run with no build: `python3 scripts/contract_versions.py --check`
**References**: [R03 frame: classes, sections, checks](../../../__reports__/contract-docs/gap_analysis_contract_docs_v0.md); [R10 §2 D4, D5, §5 D1–D4](/Users/hacker/Library/Application%20Support/Claude/side-session-notes/local_7f577b41-1698-4eeb-9de3-4ee9460ae606/m3-approved-plan.md); `crates/candler-schemas/tests/schema_drift.rs` (the mechanism mirrored); `crates/candler-schemas/tests/vectors/field_classes.toml` (the hand classes); campaign README §Gotchas, "Shared constraints" (Field classes), "M4 overlap" (the driver page)

## Step 1: The generator and the six pages
**Goal**: A drift test generates the Version and Fields sections of six pages from the committed schemas, keeps their hand-written Surface text, and the pages are committed.
**Implementation Logic**:
1. Write D1 and D2 first, with a minimal `crates/candler/tests/contract_pages.rs` that reads and checks, and see them red (no pages): this is the guards-first state. Do not commit it.
2. The pages, one file each under `docs/contract/`, mapped to the committed schema files in `crates/candler-schemas/schema/`:

   | Page | Schema roots |
   |---|---|
   | `plugin-manifest.md` | `plugin-manifest` |
   | `suite-file.md` | `suite` |
   | `evaluator-protocol.md` | `evaluator-describe-result`, `evaluator-evaluate-params`, `evaluator-message`, `evaluator-notification`, `evaluator-request-side` (five files) |
   | `outcome-record.md` | `outcome-record` |
   | `experiment-file.md` | `experiment` |
   | `evaluator-helper.md` | none of its own: the properties of `outcome-record` whose class is not `candler`, which is what a kind returns through the helper, and its version from `python/candler-evaluator/pyproject.toml` |
3. Every page holds, as `##` headings and in this order, `Surface`, `Version`, `Fields`, `Refusals`, `Notes`, and no other `##` heading. A `###` heading is allowed inside Fields to name one root of a page that has several.
4. `crates/candler/tests/contract_pages.rs`, with its support under `crates/candler/tests/support/contract_pages/` (loaded with `#[path = …]` as `guard_cli_run.rs` loads `cli_run.rs`):
   - It reads the committed `*.schema.json` files and the manifests, never the Rust types (R10 D4), and renders the generated sections. `CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT=1` writes the pages instead of comparing, as `CANDLER_BLESS_SCHEMAS=1` does; the env name is a constant beside the code.
   - **Hand text survives.** The Surface section (one sentence: what the surface is, who writes it, who reads it) and the Notes section are the file's own text: the generator copies them from the existing file and replaces only the generated sections, which sit between marker comments. A new page starts with a Surface sentence you write now. D1 compares the whole file.
   - **Version** (generated): the wire line and tag (`experiment/1`, the protocol's version), and the version numbers read from the manifests, inside one marker block (see Step 2).
   - **Fields** (generated): one row per property, reached through `$ref` into `$defs`, with a cycle guard and a depth cap. Columns: path (dotted, `[]` for an array item, `*` for a map entry), type (`type`, a `const` as its value, an `enum` as its values, a `$ref` as its name), class, default (the `default` keyword, else `-`). A union (`oneOf`/`anyOf`) is one block per alternative, titled by its `const` discriminator (`method`, `kind`) when it has one. A map-valued property is one row. Order: the files' own key order.
   - **Class** (D4): `x-candler-class` if present, else `required` if the property is in its object's `required`, else `optional`. This is the same rule as the schemas leaf's table; do not re-derive it differently.
   - **Refusals** and **Notes** are placeholders this leaf: the Refusals section is its heading, a marker comment, and nothing else; the Notes section is its heading and nothing. `docs_refusals` fills them.
5. D1, `d1_regenerating_the_pages_changes_nothing`, and a second guard `d1_fields_agree_with_the_hand_classes`: every row of `crates/candler-schemas/tests/vectors/field_classes.toml` equals the class the generated Fields table gives that path (the oracle is the hand table, not the generator). D2, `d2_each_page_has_the_five_sections_in_order`, with unit rows on hand-written bad pages (an extra section, wrong order, 121 words, an unstamped note) and on every real page. The note stamp is `[checked: <line>@<version>]` with a line of `schemas`, `v` or `candler-evaluator`.
6. Run with `CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT=1` once, read each page for sense (a union rendered as a mess means the rendering rule is wrong, not the page), then run without it.
**Deliverables**: `crates/candler/tests/contract_pages.rs`: `d1_regenerating_the_pages_changes_nothing`, `d1_fields_agree_with_the_hand_classes`, `d2_each_page_has_the_five_sections_in_order`; `crates/candler/tests/support/contract_pages/`: schema walk, class rule, page renderer, hand-section carrier; `docs/contract/{plugin-manifest,suite-file,evaluator-protocol,outcome-record,experiment-file,evaluator-helper}.md`
**Consistency Checks**: `CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT=1 cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'binary(contract_pages)' && cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'test(/^d1_/)|test(/^d2_/)'` (expected: PASS)
**Commit**: `docs(contributing): generate the contract pages for six surfaces`

## Step 2: The index and the compatibility table
**Goal**: `index.md` lists the pages and holds the generated compatibility table; the driver page has its reserved slot.
**Implementation Logic**:
1. Write D4 first (`d4_compatibility_table_equals_the_manifests`) and see it red with no index. It reads the table from `docs/contract/index.md` and compares: the core `v` with the workspace `version` of `Cargo.toml`, `schemas@` with `crates/candler-schemas/Cargo.toml`, `candler-evaluator@` with `python/candler-evaluator/pyproject.toml`. Oracle: those manifests.
2. Generate `docs/contract/index.md`: one row per page (file, surface, who writes it, wire tag), the reserved row for `driver-traits.md` (written by hand by the driver milestone, not generated, not listed as drift), and the compatibility table (`schemas@`, core `v`, `candler-evaluator@`). The generator lists `driver-traits.md` and never reads, writes or checks the file; the milestone that merges to `main` second folds it into the generator.
3. The index is in D1's comparison; D2 does not apply to it (it has no five sections), and the test says so by name.
4. **The version text and the release commit** (ruled by the coordinator, 2026-11-11). The release job commits new versions into `Cargo.toml` and the changelogs after each merge (`ci.yml`, "Commit the new versions and changelogs", `[skip ci]`), so any page quoting a version would go stale on `main` after every release. The pages are read for their versions, so they must stay true:
   - every version number of the pages sits inside `<!-- versions -->` … `<!-- /versions -->` blocks;
   - `scripts/contract_versions.py` rewrites exactly those blocks from `Cargo.toml`, `crates/candler-schemas/Cargo.toml` and `python/candler-evaluator/pyproject.toml`. It is Python 3.11+ standard library only (`tomllib`), with no build, and has a `--check` mode;
   - D1 compares the whole files, and D4 compares the blocks with the manifests: both stay strict;
   - the coordinator, not this leaf, adds one step to the release job, between `release-plz update` and `git add -A`: `python3 scripts/contract_versions.py`. The version commit then carries the refreshed blocks. That is a `ci(release)` commit, which the coordinator makes in the same milestone merge (`.github/` is the coordinator's).
**Deliverables**: `docs/contract/index.md`; `crates/candler/tests/contract_pages.rs`: `d4_compatibility_table_equals_the_manifests`; `crates/candler/tests/support/contract_pages/`: the index renderer, the version blocks; `scripts/contract_versions.py` (`--check`)
**Consistency Checks**: `cargo nextest run -p candler --no-tests=fail -E 'test(/^d1_/)|test(/^d2_/)|test(/^d4_/)' && python3 scripts/contract_versions.py --check && git diff --quiet HEAD -- docs/contract/driver-traits.md` (expected: PASS)
**Commit**: `docs(contributing): index the contract pages and their versions`

## Step 3: Record the frame in CONTRIBUTING
**Goal**: A reader of `CONTRIBUTING.md` finds where the pages live, what they hold, how they are regenerated and what is checked.
**Implementation Logic**:
1. Add `## Contract pages` to `CONTRIBUTING.md`, a table of contents entry if the file has one, and a short section, in the file's own register:
   - the pages live under `docs/contract/`, one per surface, plus the index; the reader is a coding agent, so they hold tables and rules, no narrative;
   - the five sections in order and where each comes from (Surface and Notes by hand, Version and Fields generated from the committed schema files and manifests, Refusals generated from the code's catalog and `docs/contract/codes.toml`);
   - the four field classes, in a table, one per field;
   - Notes: tentative, at most 120 words a page, each stamped `[checked: <line>@<version>]`;
   - regenerate with `CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT=1 cargo nextest run -p candler -E 'binary(contract_pages)'`;
   - `codes.toml` is append-only: a released code is never renamed or removed;
   - what is checked, by which test: D1 to D4's names.
2. State no development process: no milestone, no roadmap, no amendment, no leaf. The gate greps for it.
3. Touch no other section.
**Deliverables**: `CONTRIBUTING.md`: `## Contract pages`
**Consistency Checks**: `awk '/^## Contract pages/{f=1;next} /^## /{f=0} f' CONTRIBUTING.md | grep -q 'CANDLER_BLESS_CONTRACT' && test -z "$(awk '/^## Contract pages/{f=1;next} /^## /{f=0} f' CONTRIBUTING.md | grep -i -E 'milestone|roadmap|amendment|leaf|campaign')"` (expected: PASS)
**Commit**: `docs(contributing): record the contract pages' frame`
